blogTitle: bens ninja log (training arc) (its all a training arc)
about: im ben!! im gonna be the greatest ninja this town has ever seen and then everybody will have to respect me, BELIEVE IT!! i wear my headband to school every day (my nana sewed it. the metal part is a peach can lid she filed down so its safe). i run w/ my arms back bc its faster (my mile got slower but thats a wind thing). i train at the park behind the kroger every day at 4. current stats: pull-ups 3 (it was 0 in june), tree walking 2 steps, shadow clones 0 (SO FAR). i watch naruto every saturday at 9 on toonami IN ENGLISH and i dont care what anime club says about it. i have eaten ramen 61 days in a row. nana puts an egg in it.
aboutMore: more facts: squad 7 is me, tj and kevin (kevin doesnt know yet). my rival is devon. hes my sasuke. he says hes 'just my card guy' which is EXACTLY what sasuke would say. i wear my moms pink 2 pound ankle weights under my jeans so that one day i can take them off and everyone gasps. i am on probation in anime club for quoting the dub (14 times in 1 meeting, usagi counted). nana watches every episode w/ me and thinks sasuke 'needs to call home.' i dont have the heart to explain.
meet: naruto (hes a cartoon. i KNOW, mom). a real ninja (tj says u cant meet one, thats the whole point of them). whoever is in charge of the gym fitness test, so i can ask them to add tree walking. and a full squad. (i have a squad.) (kevin pls respond.)

blog.title: THE CHUNIN EXAM (gym fitness test) REPORT
blog.body: ok so the chunin exam (coach petrakis keeps calling it 'the fitness test') was today. RESULTS. mile run: i did arms back for lap 1 and coach said 'ben. please.' so i did arms normal for laps 2 thru 4 and got 9:31 which is my best ever. sit and reach: shins. (training continues.) curl-ups: 38. PULL-UPS. ok. in june i got 0 and just hung there and a kid named travis said 'hes stuck.' today i got 4. FOUR. i dropped down and nobody said anything and then coach wrote it on the clipboard and said 'thats what showing up every day looks like, son.' i didnt pass the whole thing. u need 5 pull-ups for the patch. i need 1 more. rock lee would say thats not failing, thats just next time. nana made ramen w/ an egg AND a cut up hot dog in it bc its a special occasion. BELIEVE IT

blog.title: how i got my headband (the origin story)
blog.body: ppl ask where i bought my headband. u cant buy it. heres the true story. last winter i asked for a real one for my birthday and mom said $25 was too much for 'a ribbon w/ a plate on it.' i was sad for like a whole day. then nana called me into the sewing room. she had blue cloth from the quilt box and a peach can lid and she said 'show me the cartoon.' so i paused the tape on narutos forehead and she looked at it thru her reading glasses for a long time. she filed the lid so its not sharp. she let me draw the leaf w/ a sharpie. my hand slipped so it kinda looks like a snail. she said 'thats a fine snail.' i said its a leaf. she said 'thats a fine leaf.' ive worn it every day since. kids say stuff sometimes. i dont care. a real one is $25. mine has nana in it.

blog.title: why i watch the dub (official statement)
blog.body: anime club (usagi) keeps saying i watch it 'wrong.' here is my official statement. 1) i watch it saturdays at 9 w/ my nana. nana cant read subtitles that fast. if its in japanese i have to read every line out loud to her and do the voices, and last time i tried she said 'benjamin u sound like a tea kettle.' 2) in english i can watch AND do the hand signs at the same time. 3) believe it is a GOOD catchphrase. it means believe it. 4) usagi says the original has more feeling. i have cried in english 3 times already so the feeling is getting thru fine. 5) im sorry about the jelly donuts. i thought thats what they were. a different show told me that. i brought them as a peace offering and it went really bad. anyway i respect subs. i just have a nana. thats my ninja way.
